contexts.text: Unless the celestial and spiritual things... presented themselves... NJHD 51:3.
While man is being regenerated, charity meets faith; that is, good meets truth...
The Angels of God met him () = illustration by good.
The good... inflows into the will, and there meets the good of truth...
Interior light... meets those things which have entered through the external sight.
Jehovah the God of the Hebrews hath met us () = the Divine of the Lord in the Church, and His command... To meet, here, = what is commanded. Explained. AC 7099.
He met him in the Mount of God () = conjunction in the good of love there. To meet, or to come to meet = conjunction.
They met Moses and Aaron () = thought concerning the law Divine and the derivative doctrine. To meet = thought. Explained.
God made it meet to his hand () = appearing as if chance.
Good from the Lord there meets the truths which have entered by an external way.
To meet them as a bear bereaved () = the falsification of the sense of the letter.
